articles.title: Visa combines VisaNet data with onchain lending to power stablecoin card working capital
articles.snippet: Visa's stablecoin settlement volume surpassed a $20 billion annualized run rate, up 15x year over year. Now it wants blockchain lenders to use that data to extend credit to the issuers driving the growth.

articles.title: Ethereum makes quantum resistance a top priority with a 2029 deadline
articles.snippet: The Foundation wants the network protected before a quantum computer capable of breaking today's cryptography could plausibly arrive, and says upcoming upgrades will be judged against that clock.

articles.title: Bitmine purchased another $69 million of ETH, with Tom DeMark expecting price uptrend to soon resume
articles.snippet: At the latest purchase pace, Tom Lee's Ethereum treasury firm could reach its crypto accumulation goal in another seven weeks.

articles.title: Stablecoins could save South Korean merchants up to $3.8 billion a year, budget office says
articles.snippet: South Korea’s budget office warned that stablecoin adoption could reduce banks' roles as credit intermediaries and potentially destabilize token pegs during mass redemptions.

articles.title: Tracking cocoa may be just the beginning for PwC, Merck, Hashgraph provenance system
articles.snippet: The firms say their combination of physical authentication, digital traceability and enterprise process design has no precedent in supply chains, and cocoa is just the start.
